input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The check changed from self.match.match(...) to self.match.fullmatch(...), which silently alters matching semantics beyond the announced empty-message change. Patterns that previously matched a prefix of the exception text no longer match.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception with str "Connection refused". Before, re.match anchored at the start returned a match, so the retry happened. After, fullmatch requires the whole string to match, so the check returns False and the retry is skipped. Impact: existing callers that rely on prefix matching stop retrying on transient errors, and the commit title does not announce this change.
critique: The finding identifies the switch to fullmatch, which requires the whole exception message to match. It shows that a message with a matching prefix plus extra text, "Connection refused", now makes the retry predicate return False so no retry happens. This is the same mechanism and failure path as the labeled defect.
